scope: Preregistered design for future held-out evaluation; not a completed benchmark

retrieval.aggregation: macro per query within each family; counterpart gate additionally every eligible comparison query; no pooling families
retrieval.missing: not_evaluated; never omit missing queries from acceptance denominator
retrieval.gain: linear nonnegative grades; 0 irrelevant, 1 relevant supporting context, 2 directly answers material issue

rationale.k5: Bound the first evidence set to five passages for reviewer inspection; independent of known three-query scores. Both sides must fit or expose a budget failure; never trim qrels to force feasibility.
rationale.k20: Candidate-stage diagnostic to separate candidate recall from reranking; not a second chance acceptance gate.
rationale.recall: Prospective retrieval objective: retrieve at least 90% of relevant evidence on average per family in the primary budget; differs from change-detector recall95%.
rationale.ndcg: Prospective ordering utility objective of at least80% ideal linear-gain DCG; not an empirically established safety threshold.
rationale.counterparts: Every comparison needs at least one verified passage on each side; perfect counterpart presence does not imply all relevant evidence or entailment.

partitions.unit: complete before/after pair and connected document/version/derivation/neighbor/amendment component
partitions.development: Known pilot and Astra003/004/005 are exposed development/review evidence; do not relabel as reserved
partitions.target_pair_count: up to10 per family, not minimum10
partitions.unknown_lineage: not_evaluated until resolved; absence of byte overlap alone is insufficient

freeze_rules: Do not modify thresholds after viewing new held-out outputs. Any revision creates a new design and preserves prior result.
Populate real original/corpus/question hashes, qrels and counterpart maps, complete tune/holdout partitions and provenance before freeze_protocol.
freeze_protocol remains unchanged; pending empty references must not be passed as valid frozen protocol.
Gold may not be solely produced/approved by the evaluated model; preserve reviewer independence, AI provenance and disagreements. AI pilot permitted; expert-reference acceptance remains separate.
